# Standalone IsoMax

Download `iteathen-isomax-0.2.0-rc.5.tgz`, verify its SHA-256 against
`SHA256SUMS`, and extract the complete `package/` folder. From that folder:

```sh
node verify.mjs
node run.mjs
```

Node 26.7 or later is required. No npm install, submodule or producer checkout is
needed. The archive contains the same locked files as the adjacent distribution.
